core.headline: Mid-terrace house, Sheerness – guide price £150,000
core.summary: For sale by Modern Method of Auction. Two-bedroom mid-terrace house in Sheerness requiring modernisation, with rear yard and no onward chain. Non-refundable reservation fee of 4.2% of the purchase price (minimum £6,000).
core.listing:
For sale by Modern Method of Auction. This two-bedroom mid-terrace house is located at Station Terrace, Sheerness. The property requires modernisation and is offered with no onward chain.

The ground floor provides a reception room. The first floor offers two bedrooms and a bathroom.

Outside, there is a rear yard. On-street parking is available with no permit required.

Sheerness is served by mains electricity, mains water (metered), mains sewerage and gas central heating. FTTC broadband is available, and there is good outdoor mobile signal coverage on major networks.

Guide Price £150,000. For sale by Modern Method of Auction with a 56-day reservation period. The guide price indicates the seller's minimum expectation; the reserve will be within 10% of the guide. A non-refundable reservation fee of 4.2% of the purchase price (minimum £6,000) including VAT is payable by the buyer in addition to the purchase price. Freehold. Council Tax Band A (Swale Borough Council). EPC rating E. No onward chain. Building safety, restrictions, rights and easements, flooding, coastal erosion, planning, accessibility and coalfield/mining: none known.
keyFeatures: For sale by Modern Method of Auction
